heard: NASA lowered a car-sized rover onto Mars using hovering rockets. Earlier rovers survived landing by bouncing inside giant inflatable airbags, but at nearly one ton, Curiosity was far too heavy. A heat shield and giant parachute slowed its supersonic fall. Then a rocket-powered sky crane ignited thrusters and hovered above Mars. Tether cables lowered the rover directly onto its six wheels. Explosive cutters severed the lines, letting the crane fly away. No simpler method could safely land a vehicle that heavy.
